data.body:
[P2] Preserve the admission exception during automatic close

When remaining invocation time is already at or below 500 ms during root submission, `checkInvocationAdmission()` records and throws a lifecycle exception before `invocation.execute()` returns. Explicit finalization is therefore skipped, and automatic `close()` returns and rethrows that same exception instance here. Try-with-resources then attempts self-suppression, replacing the retryable exception with `IllegalArgumentException: Self-suppression not permitted`. Finalize synchronous admission/dispatch failures with their original failure before automatic close, or otherwise prevent close from rethrowing the active exception instance. Add a regression for a context whose deadline has expired before root submission.
